title: AeroWell A9 atmospheric water generator: drinking water from air | Aquemi
meta: The AeroWell A9 condenses moisture from the air and filters it into drinking water: 9 US gal (34 L) a day at 26 °C and 60 % RH from a 120 V outlet, for RVs, boats and off-grid sites.
eyebrow: PRODUCTS · AEROWELL A9 · ATMOSPHERIC WATER GENERATOR
headline: Drinking water from the air, on a 120 V outlet
lead: The AeroWell A9 draws in air, condenses its moisture and filters it into drinking water: 9 US gal a day at 26 °C and 60 % humidity. For RVs, boats and off-grid sites.

blocks.intro: Air in, drinking water at the dispenser. Production rises with warm, humid air and falls with dry or cold air.

stages.label: Air
stages.d: A MERV 13 filter cleans the air drawn in.

stages.label: Cool
stages.d: The air is cooled below its dew point and its moisture condenses.

stages.label: Filter
stages.d: Four filtration stages, then a mineralizer for taste.

stages.label: UV
stages.d: Ultraviolet light sterilizes the water before storage.

stages.label: Out
stages.d: 1.8 US gal (6.8 L) internal storage; the dispenser delivers 1 US gal/min (3.8 L/min).

blocks.caption: AeroWell A9

rows.v: 580 W nominal, 865 W peak; 120 V, 60 Hz
MERV 13 air filter; four water filtration stages and a mineralizer; LED UV sterilization

blocks.note: Production at your site depends on temperature and humidity.

items.q: How much water will it make at my site?
items.a: It depends on temperature and humidity. The 9 US gal/day rating is at 26 °C and 60 % RH; drier or colder air makes less. Send your typical conditions and we reply with an estimate.

items.q: Is the water safe to drink?
items.a: The condensed water passes four filtration stages, a mineralizer and LED UV sterilization. Certifications held: [AeroWell certifications held].
Routine checks and filter changes every 6 to 12 months, depending on use and air quality.

items.q: Can it be built into a vehicle or a product?
items.a: Yes. We design custom versions for manufacturers who want water generation in their coaches, boats or off-grid products.

cta.body: Tell us the product and where it will work. An engineer replies in writing with price and lead time.
